messages.text:
The last failures are environmental plus test isolation: a dev server left port 3000 occupied and also held the default SQLite file, which made DB reset fail.

I’m stopping only the process bound to this workspace’s port 3000 and isolating tests onto their own SQLite file so app serving can’t lock test data.
